meta.name: La Ley y el Orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
meta.description: Serie surgida a la sombra de "Law & Order". Una unidad especial de la policía de Nueva York se dedica a investigar delitos de carácter sexual: violaciones, pedofilia y malos tratos infantiles.

trailers.name: La Ley y el Orden: UVE - Temporada 21 | Estreno 29 de octubre

trailerStreams.title: La Ley y el Orden: UVE - Temporada 21 | Estreno 29 de octubre

videos.title: la Venganza
videos.overview: Los detectives Stabler y Benson investigan el asesinato y mutilación de un taxista a quien alguien quería dar caza.

videos.title: Una vida de soltera
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler se encuentran con varios callejones sin salida cuando investigan el caso de una mujer que murió al caer por una ventana vestida únicamente con un camisón

videos.title: ...O Solo Parecer Una
videos.overview: Cuando una conocida adolescente sufre una agresión sexual, Benson y Stabler se ven obligados a sumergirse en un inframundo de modelos formado por padres inconscientes, médicos que trafican con fármacos y la directora de una agencia de modelos (interpretada por Bebe Neuwirth)

videos.title: Histeria
videos.overview: Los detectives Benson y Stabler creen que un compañero suyo podría estar implicado en unos asesinatos que se remontan 30 años atrás; Munch está extraordinariamente bien durante un caso de pederastia. Con la actuación del artista invitado: Jerry Orbach. También intervienen en el reparto Dann Florek, Dean Winters y Michelle Hurd. Jerry Orbach interpreta al detective Lennie Briscoe de Ley y orden.

videos.title: Ansias de Viajar
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler creen que un pedófilo puede estar detrás del asesinato de un escritor de viajes.

videos.title: Broma Estudiantil
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler sospechan de un par de jugadores universitarios de baloncesto de asesinar a una estudiante, pero los directivos no quieren atraer atención negativa hacia la institución. Richard Belzer, Dann Florek, Dean Winters y Michelle Hurd también actúan.

videos.title: Incivilizado
videos.overview: Un niño es violado y asesinado en Central Park y todo conduce a un delincuente sexual liberado.

videos.title: Acosado
videos.overview: Una ADA que había trabajado en delitos sexuales es violada y asesinada.

videos.title: Acciones y Ataduras
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler investigan la sospechosa muerte de una mujer exitosa y se ven envueltos en el mundo del sadomasoquismo.

videos.title: Superación
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler se encuentran con problemas cuando el principal sospechoso de un ataque sexual no puede ser identificado por la perturbada víctima (estrella invitada Tracy Pollan).

videos.title: Hostilidad
videos.overview: Los detectives Benson y Stabler buscan al asesino de un homosexual cuyo padre dirige un grupo de vigilancia conservador. Munch busca al padre biológico de Benson

videos.title: Poema de Amor Ruso
videos.overview: Un sospechoso grupo de inmigrantes rusos ayuda a Stabler y Benson (Christopher Meloni, Mariska Hargitay) a resolver el homicidio de un multimillonario.

videos.title: Desnudo
videos.overview: Los detectives Benson y Stabler investigan la muerte de un ruin juez que abusó del sistema de justicia penal. Estrella invitada, Angie Everhart

videos.title: Limitaciones
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler tienen mucho trabajo que hacer cuando un caso de agresión sexual de hace cinco años se reabre días antes de que se venza el plazo de prescripción

videos.title: Con Derecho, Parte Uno
videos.overview: La hija de un miembro de la alta sociedad (estrella invitada Jane Alexander) podría ser la responsable de la muerte de un supuesto depredador sexual.

videos.title: El Tercero
videos.overview: Dos pandillas están involucradas en el asesinato y violación de una anciana, aunque ellos afirman que solo entraron a robar.

videos.title: Engaño
videos.overview: Cuando la nuera embarazada de una prominente figura religiosa (estrella invitada Robert Foxworth) es encontrada atada en la habitación de un hotel, queda en evidencia que podría haber tenido un romance.

videos.title: Chat Room
videos.overview: Un caso sobre agresión sexual que involucra a dos adolescentes lleva a Benson y Stabler (Mariska Hargitay, Christopher Meloni) a preparar una operación encubierta para atrapar pedófilos en Internet.

videos.title: Contacto
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler se ven frustrados por una serie de ataques sexuales hacia mujeres que ocurren en vagones de metros llenos de gente.

videos.title: Remordimiento
videos.overview: El detective Munch estrecha vínculos con una periodista de televisión que fue agredida sexualmente por dos hombres, pero son Benson y Stabler quienes hacen el primer arresto.

videos.title: Nocturno
videos.overview: El juicio de un acusado pedófilo peligra cuando el principal testigo tiene dificultad para lidiar con su pasado.

videos.title: Esclavas
videos.overview: Un abogado (estrella invitada Andrew McCarthy) sospechoso por tener una inmigrante rumana como esclava sexual es relacionado con el asesinato de una mujer.

videos.title: El Mal Está Bien
videos.overview: Un científico espacial con fuertes lazos con la seguridad gubernamental es hallado muerto con su entrepierna en llamas y los detectives de la Unidad de Víctimas Especiales deben determinar si eso tuvo algo que ver con su deceso.

videos.title: Honor
videos.overview: Cuando una joven mujer es hallada violada, golpeada y apuñalada en Central Park, parece que fue víctima de un ataque de una pandilla. Los detectives interrogan a un acomodado adolescente convertido en delincuente, pero él tenía una coartada.

videos.title: Superación , Parte Dos
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler (Mariska Hargitay, Christopher Meloni) descubren que están trabajando el mismo caso que una víctima de agresión sexual (estrella invitada Tracy Pollan) cuando investigan las actividades de un presunto violador sin condenar (estrella invitada Neil Maffin).

videos.title: Legado
videos.overview: Una niña abusada de siete años se encuentra en estado de coma mientras Benson y Stabler (Mariska Hargitay, Christopher Meloni) intentan descubrir qué miembro de su familia disfuncional es el responsable de su estado.

videos.title: Niño Asesino
videos.overview: El disparo mortal a un escolar causado por su compañero de siete años lleva a nueva información sobre un asesinato sin resolver.

videos.title: Incumplimiento
videos.overview: La cuestión de los derechos de los pacientes surge cuando un hombre con problemas mentales que no quiere tomar su medicación es un sospechoso en el asesinato de una estudiante de psiquiatría.

videos.title: Separados
videos.overview: La verdad detrás de la supuesta violación a una mujer (estrella invitada Amy Carlson) por parte de su esposo policía (estrella invitada Néstor Serrano) sale a la luz cuando una historia de abuso doméstico se revela. Con Christopher Meloni y Mariska Hargitay.

videos.title: Atrapados
videos.overview: El caso de una víctima de violación de 17 años (estrella invitada Jenna Miller) toma un giro inesperado cuando su familia intenta mantener el escándalo en silencio mientras preparan una demanda.

videos.title: Haditas
videos.overview: Una gimnasta adolescente es hallada violada y asesinada. Los principales sospechosos son su entrenador autoritario y el patrocinador del equipo masculino con quien ella tenía una aventura.

videos.title: Consentimiento
videos.overview: Cuando una estudiante universitaria, Kelly D'Leah (estrella invitada Tammy Blanchard) es hallada inconsciente en el campus, con evidencia de ataque sexual y sin recuerdos de la noche anterior, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) deben determinar qué fue lo que llevó a la supuesta violación de la muchacha.

videos.title: Abuso
videos.overview: La unidad investiga la muerte del hijo de una popular cantante en un accidente de tránsito, descubren que debido a la carrera de su madre, los hijos sufren de abandono emocional. Benson pone en riesgo su trabajo para ayudar a la olvidada hija, pero este delito de abuso, ¿merece la encarcelación?

videos.title: Secretos
videos.overview: Cuando encuentran a una muy respeta maestra abusada y sin vida, sus estudiantes y colegas lloran la muerte de la talentosa educadora. Pero cuando los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) encuentran una foto de la mujer desnuda en casa de uno de sus estudiantes, deben cuestionarse qué tipo de conocimiento impartía a sus estudiantes.

videos.title: Víctimas
videos.overview: Thomas Marchek, un pedófilo convicto, es asesinado en su propio vecindario bajo la atenta mirada de un justiciero que claramente no lo quiere cerca. Los detectives interrogan a los padres de la pequeña Corinne (Briana Steinhilber), de quien Marchek abusó, y cuya madre podría ser sospechosa.

videos.title: Paranoia
videos.overview: Karen Smythe (Khandi Alexander) es una oficial de policía que responde una llamada de rutina con su compañero, Mitch Murray (Jason Kolotouros), pero se separan y Karen desaparece en un deposito donde es brutalmente abusada y casi asesinada.

videos.title: Cuenta Regresiva
videos.overview: Los detectives de la UVE tienen 72 horas para salvar a una pequeña que fue secuestrada por un asesino serial. Las mejores pistas yacen en la memoria de una niña que pudo escapar de su captor. Desafortunadamente, la madre de la niña les niega a los detectives hablar con su hija tratando de protegerla para que no sufra más estrés.

videos.title: Prófugo
videos.overview: La búsqueda de una joven fugitiva conduce a los detectives Benson y Stabler (Mariska Hargitay, Christopher Meloni) a un culto rave clandestino que asiste a adolescentes rebeldes.

videos.title: Locura
videos.overview: El joven Tommy Dowd (Eddie Cahill), es violentamente agredido en un exclusivo hotel, todo conduce a un servicio de acompañantes que provee hombres jóvenes a mujeres que necesitan compañía para asistir a eventos de alto nivel.

videos.title: Cacería
videos.overview: Cuando la joven Annie Tassler (estrella invitada Meg Hartig) es secuestrada, el detective Munch (Richard Belzer) descubre que los detalles del crimen son similares a los de una serie de brutales violaciones y homicidios que investigó, sin demasiado éxito, el año anterior.

videos.title: Parásitos
videos.overview: Encuentran los restos de una mujer tres años después de su muerte, los detectives deben encontrar al responsable. Una fotografía los conduce a la hermana gemela de la víctima.

videos.title: Rencor
videos.overview: Un joven cuya extraña relación con su madre lo llevó a desarrollar un inusual fetiche sexual llamado "piquerismo" que consiste en dañar la piel, es acusado de violación y homicidio

videos.title: Flagelo
videos.overview: Cuando un asesino serial comete cuatro brutales asesinatos en 24 horas, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay), Munch (Richard Belzer) y Fin (Ice-T) recorren las calles de la ciudad buscando señales de un lunático que exclama retorcidos dichos religiosos mientras comete sus crímenes. Estrellas invitadas, Richard Thomas y Karen Allen.

videos.title: Represión
videos.overview: Una joven mujer con el síndrome de memoria reprimida de pronto recuerda que su padre la abusó de pequeña. Esta revelación rompe su familia aparentemente normal cuando presenta cargos contra su padre, que luego aparece muerto.

videos.title: Ira
videos.overview: Cuando tres personas sin vínculo, pero conectados con casos que fueron tratados por la detective Benson (Mariska Hargitay) son halladas asesinadas bajo formas rituales, toda la evidencia apunta a Benson como el verdadero blanco de la violencia. Mientras lucha con la culpa por estos asesinatos, Benson sigue buscando al asaltante a pesar de las advertencias del FBI de que podría estar en peligro.

videos.title: Robados
videos.overview: Cuando roban un bebé a su madre en una tienda de abarrotes, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) pronto descubren que el secuestro es solo la punta del iceberg en un plan de robo y venta de bebés.

videos.title: Azotea
videos.overview: Cuando un violento violador es liberado de prisión, Stabler está convencido de que no pasará mucho tiempo hasta que el hombre regrese a sus viejos hábitos. De hecho, violaciones que coindicen con el modus operandi del hombre empiezan a ocurrir y el caso se vuelve personal ya que Stabler acecha al hombre para evitar que cometa otro crimen.

videos.title: Enredados
videos.overview: Cuando un ataque que sale mal resulta en la muerte de un reconocido doctor y la violación de su esposa, la investigación revela un infame triángulo amoroso.

videos.title: Redención
videos.overview: Stabler comienza a perder fe en el sistema cuando aparece un caso que lo une con un policía deshonesto cuya fe ya está perdida.

videos.title: Sacrificio
videos.overview: Un hombre es hallado baleado y violado afuera de un bar gay. Cuando Benson y Stabler intentan ayudar a la víctima, él desaparece del hospital y no cooperará con la investigación. Luego se sabe que el hombre actúa en películas pornográficas gais para pagar las facturas médicas de su hija, que sufre de fibrosis cística.

videos.title: Herencia
videos.overview: Mujeres asiáticas en Chinatown son las víctimas de un violador y asesino serial. Se halla ADN en una de las escenas del crimen, y esto los lleva a un prisionero moribundo afroamericano que cometió varias violaciones 25 años antes.

videos.title: Cuidados
videos.overview: Cuando se halla el cuerpo golpeado de una niña de cinco años bajo guarda tutelar asesinada, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) deben explorar un complejo despliegue de conexiones familiares en su búsqueda por un motivo y un asesino. Actúa en este episodio Piper Laurie, nominada al Premio de la Academia.

videos.title: Ridículo
videos.overview: Cuando una joven esposa es hallada muerta después de lo que parece haber sido un auto encuentro erótico, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) descubren que la fallecida y su grupo de amigas fueron recientemente acusadas de haber violado a un estríper (estrella invitada Pete Starrett).

videos.title: Monogamia
videos.overview: Una mujer que es supuestamente violada y recibe una cesárea forzada en un callejón, que la deja en estado crítico. Su bebé desapareció y la UVE corre para hallarlo.

videos.title: Protección
videos.overview: Una mujer lleva a su hijo al hospital después de recibir un disparo durante un tiroteo, luego desaparece cuando llega la policía. Los detectives de la unidad descubren que la mujer es la novia de un líder narcotraficante. Ahora teme que su novio intente matarla a ella y a su familia.

videos.title: Prodigio
videos.overview: La muerte de una trabajadora en control animal conduce a la historia que detalla las señales tempranas de un asesino serial. El protagonista es un brillante joven marginado, conocido por su crueldad con los animales. Aunque las sospechas van hacia otra dirección, los detectives saben que en el futuro tendrán que lidiar con este retorcido joven.

videos.title: Falso
videos.overview: El hallazgo de una mujer violada y sin vida cerca de su auto obliga a los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Fin (Ice-T) a trabajar juntos para determinar el motivo de la muerte y descubrir por qué el baúl del auto de la víctima estaba lleno de medicamentos falsos.

videos.title: Ejecución
videos.overview: Un caso sin resolver en el que Stabler trabajó una vez resurge cuando los padres de la víctima van a él asegurando saber quién asesinó a su hija. En un giro irónico, el hombre a identificar se encuentra en el corredor de la muerte por otro homicidio.

videos.title: Popular
videos.overview: Stabler entra en acción cuando su esposa, Kathy, le cuenta que una amiga enfermera atendió a una víctima de violación de 14 años que se negó a denunciar el crimen. Traicionando la confianza de su mujer, Stabler busca a la joven, acompañado de Benson. Después de que Kathy y su jefe, Cragen, se enojaran con él, logra identificar a la víctima y descubre un perturbador club de sexo adolescente.

videos.title: Vigilancia
videos.overview: Una mujer es encontrada golpeada en su apartamento, la investigación en la escena del crimen encuentra cámaras ocultas en el apartamento de la víctima.

videos.title: Culpa
videos.overview: Una mujer embarazada desaparece y su exnovio está bajo sospecha.

videos.title: Justicia
videos.overview: Después de ser abusada y agredida, una estudiante muere en la sala de operaciones antes de que Benson pueda hacer un identikit del violador. Benson y Stabler descubren que la víctima es Patricia Stephens, hijastra de un juez.

videos.title: Codicia
videos.overview: Una mujer es atacada en su casa y dada por muerta, su marido no sabe quién podría querer hacerle daño. Un ataque similar ocurre en el vecindario y los detectives investigan al técnico del sistema de seguridad que trabajó en ambas casas. Pero los detectives se preguntan si tienen al hombre correcto cuando la huella digital del marido de la primera víctima es encontrada en el vehículo del técnico.

videos.title: Negación
videos.overview: Un caso de violación de rutina se convierte en algo más grande cuando los detectives descubren el dedo de un niño en el bolso de la víctima. La investigación revela que el dedo es de un pariente de la víctima, pero la víctima es una drogadicta que se niega a ayudar a los detectives. La pregunta ahora es... ¿qué le ocurrió al niño?

videos.title: Aptitud
videos.overview: Una chica con síndrome de Down está embarazada y la pregunta es, ¿fue violada o fue consentido? ¿Y es lo suficientemente competente como para quedarse con el niño?

videos.title: Silencio
videos.overview: Cuando los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) son llamados a la escena de un asesinato en una iglesia, descubren que Bobby Douglas (estrella invitada Sean Dugan), el joven responsable por el crimen, había estado recibiendo pagos de la iglesia para cubrir su abuso sexual por parte de un sacerdote. Actúa Eric Stoltz.

videos.title: Camaleón
videos.overview: Los detectives están tras la pista de un violador recientemente en libertad condicional responsable del asesinato de una prostituta durante una redada en un club de hombres y son llamados al lugar donde recibió un disparo en defensa propia con su propia arma. Sin embargo, el arma homicida también se utilizó en otro crimen mientras aún estaba en prisión, lo que llevó a los detectives a investigar a la víctima a través de un rastro de casos previamente no resueltos, un gasto excesivo y otra víctima. Descubren a un criminal más grave en el proceso.

videos.title: Engaño
videos.overview: La interrogación por el abuso a un menor se convierte en una investigación de un homicidio incestuoso.

videos.title: Vulnerable
videos.overview: Una anciana con Alzheimer es abusada, desencadenando recuerdos de crímenes similares de su infancia, pero el verdadero crimen es lo que le ocurrió hoy a la anciana.

videos.title: Lujuria
videos.overview: Una doctora en salud pública que rastreó casos de VIH es hallada muerta en el parque y los detectives intentar vincular amenazas telefónicas con el crimen.

videos.title: Desapariciones
videos.overview: Una ejecutiva poderosa es violada, pero la situación es complicada por su participación con los federales y la mafia rusa.

videos.title: Ángeles
videos.overview: Un niño se sofoca mientras se esconde en el compartimento de equipaje de un bus de aeropuerto y lleva a los detectives a una investigación de una pervertida red de abuso de menores.

videos.title: Muñecas
videos.overview: Los detectives intentan resolver el horripilante homicidio de una niña cuyo asesino tenía una obsesión con muñecas.

videos.title: Desperdicios
videos.overview: Los detectives investigan la violación de una mujer que estuvo en coma por un año y después de eliminar varios sospechosos, descubren algo sorprendente.

videos.title: Juveniles
videos.overview: Cuando una redada antidroga revela el cuerpo de un traficante de marihuana de 30 años violado y apuñalado, Fin (Ice-T) junto con los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni), usa sus viejas habilidades con narcóticos para rastrear al asesino, solo para descubrir que el ataque fue el trabajo de dos estudiantes de secundaria

videos.title: Resistencia
videos.overview: Una chica adolescente intenta suicidarse tras ser violada y se descubre que su abuso sexual estuvo en manos de su familia, con un padre más retorcido de lo que se pensaba.

videos.title: Daños
videos.overview: Un triple homicidio como resultado de un robo en una tienda de videos se convierte en una complicada investigación cuando se descubre que los asesinatos, supuestamente accidentales, fueron diseñados para callar a una niña de seis años que fue abusada sexualmente.

videos.title: Riesgo
videos.overview: Un bebé ingiere cocaína pura camuflada como fórmula para bebés, revelando una complicada red de narcóticos con participantes insólitos.

videos.title: Corrupto
videos.overview: Un recluso que fue sodomizado es hallado muerto en su celda, y como pasó estando en custodia, se sospecha de la policía.

videos.title: Compasión
videos.overview: El asesinato de una bebé resulta ser una muerte piadosa dado que tenía una extraña enfermedad mortal.

videos.title: Pandora
videos.overview: El asesinato de una informante federal encubierta que traficaba pornografía por Internet, se convierte en un caso internacional de prostitución adolescente, con lazos con la República Checa.

videos.title: Torturada
videos.overview: Una mujer tibetana que fue torturada en su país de origen es encontrada asesinada, sin un pie, y después de una búsqueda exhaustiva de posibles sospechosos, el asesino es también víctima de tortura.

videos.title: Privilegios
videos.overview: Una joven estudiante de cine vestida con uniforme de sirvienta aparentemente se ha suicidado, pero es muy sospechoso. Los detectives descubren que ella acaba de romper con su rico y poderoso novio.

videos.title: Desesperación
videos.overview: Cuando una joven mujer es hallada brutalmente asesinada tras un violento ataque sexual, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) dependen del único testigo del crimen, el hijo de la mujer. Sin embargo, cuando los detectives descubren que la mujer era una esposa golpeada prófuga, centran su atención en su abusivo esposo. Sandra Bernhard y Rob Estes también actúan.

videos.title: Apariencias
videos.overview: Una princesa de concursos infantiles de nueve años es abusada y asesinada, pero el caso va más allá del asesino.

videos.title: Dominación
videos.overview: Un cuádruple homicidio con connotaciones sexuales es solo el comienzo de una intensa matanza de un asesino en serie que involucra a un detective de homicidios. Mientras todo el escuadrón corre contra el tiempo para evitar más víctimas, la evidencia descubre una horrible situación de incesto y abuso

videos.title: Falacia
videos.overview: Una víctima de violación mata a su atacante, aunque parece un caso de defensa propia, la historia tiene un giro.

videos.title: Inútil
videos.overview: Michael Gardner (Fred Savage), un adinerado profesional, es arrestado fuera de su departamento por cargos de violación. Él afirma ser inocente, pero sus huellas dactilares aparecen en la escena del crimen de la violación de Carrie Huitt (Myndy Crist).

videos.title: Dolor
videos.overview: Cuando una mesera de un popular club de Manhattan es violada y asesinada afuera del lugar, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) desconfían del ex novio enojado de la víctima. Sin embargo, cuando descubren que la víctima estaba involucrada en una aventura amorosa con el dueño del club, creen que él es el depredador.

videos.title: Perfecto
videos.overview: Cuando se encuentra el cadáver de una chica de 14 años en un callejón, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) descubren que la víctima era una adolescente desaparecida de Pennsylvania que supuestamente había sido secuestrada ocho meses antes.

videos.title: Desalmado
videos.overview: Cuando una supuesta víctima de violación es secuestrada de un hospital de Nueva York y luego asesinada, los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) buscan al asesino de la chica solo para descubrir que su ataque fue perpetrado por jóvenes y aburridos niños ricos en un popular club nocturno de Manhattan.

videos.title: Tragedia
videos.overview: Una mujer embarazada desaparece y su exnovio, padre del bebé e involucrado con la hija de su jefe, está bajo sospecha.

videos.title: Maníaco
videos.overview: Un adolescente, en un arranque frenético, mata a dos jugadores famosos de básquetbol y luego intenta suicidarse; su defensa es una serie de tratamientos psiquiátricos y medicación fallidos.

videos.title: Madre
videos.overview: Una psiquiatra con métodos poco convencionales aparece sexualmente violentada e inconsciente en una casa de crack; y no está nada fácil convencerla de que coopere con la investigación.

videos.title: Pérdida
videos.overview: Una hermosa agente de la DEA es violada y asesinada, lo que desencadena una investigación complicada que involucra a un cártel colombiano y se convierte en el caso más difícil en la carrera de Cabot.

videos.title: Suerte
videos.overview: Una mujer y su bebé recién nacido son asesinados; y el sospechoso parece ser un abusador serial de menores.

videos.title: Coacción
videos.overview: Adam Forbes (Dylan Bluestone), un niño de cinco años, desaparece de su departamente y su mamá, en un principio, culpa a su exmarido Peter (James McCaffrey), pero pronto se vuelve evidente que lo secuestró un extraño.

videos.title: Dilema
videos.overview: Durante un patrulleo, la policía presencia un ataque a la dueña del resaurante Momma Sue's, Jennifer Fulton (Jennifer Fulton).

videos.title: Abominación
videos.overview: Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Chris Meloni) se ven en aprietos para identificar a una víctima de asesinato, de sexo masculino, de una veintena de años, encontrado entre la hojarasca de West Village.

videos.title: Control
videos.overview: Horace Gorman (Austin Pendleton) se desvanece en la estación del metro. Lo llevan de urgencias al hospital y, a pesar de que sobrevive, se le han amputado los genitales.

videos.title: Zarandeo
videos.overview: Sarah Rendell (Nicole Leach), una niñera de 19 años, y Veronica Nash (Olga Merediz), una niñera mayor y oficiosa, están cuidando a unos niños en el parque. Lucy, bajo cuidado de Sarah, desaparece y llaman a la policía. Stabler (Chris Meloni) la encuentra entre los arbustos con una herida grave en la cabeza.

videos.title: Huida
videos.overview: Hay una fuga en la Correccional de Virginia. Double D (Michael Kenneth Williams) y Michael Baxter (Stephen Lang) están prófugos. El mariscal adjunto Andy Eckerson (Craig Bierko) viaja a Nueva York para aliarse con la detective Benson (Mariska Hargitay) a fin de rastrearlos.

videos.title: Fraternidad
videos.overview: El cuerpo de un joven aparece en un depósito de aguas negras en una planta de tratamiento. La M.E. Warner (Tamara Tunie) logra identificar un tatuaje que dice "TE", símbolo de la fraternidad Tau Épsilon.

videos.title: Odio
videos.overview: Una joven, Mira Elbisi, es brutalmente violada y quemada. Luego de identificar su cuerpo, Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Chris Meloni) sospechan de su marido y su suegra.

videos.title: Ritual
videos.overview: El cuerpo desmembrado de un niño negro aparece en Central Park entre lo que parece ser un tipo de ritual de la Santería: velas y pocillos con sangre. Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Chris Meloni) rastrean las velas y llegan a un grupo de santería.

videos.title: Familias
videos.overview: Un estudiante de preparatoria aparece asesinado y parece ser que fue víctima de incesto

videos.title: Hogar
videos.overview: Vecinos encuentran a un niño escuálido esculcando entre la basura. Benson (Mariska Hargitay) y Stabler (Christopher Meloni) sospechan que el niño, Jacob (Jesse Schwartz), es víctima de maltrato y se niegan a dejarlo volver a casa.

videos.title: Maldad
videos.overview: Emily Sullivan, de 16 años, aparece brutalmente asesinada en un coche. Los detectives Benson (Mariska Hargity) y Stabler (Chris Meloni) confirman la identidad de la víctima en su espléndida casa en Westchester, donde los padres les informan que debería haber dormido en casa de Andrea Kent (Arielle Kebbel) esa noche.

videos.title: Descuido
videos.overview: Un niño de seis años llega a urgencias desde una misa de medianoche porque ha parado de respirar. Sam (Cress Williams) y Lori-Ann Dufoy (Malinda Williams) son sus padres adoptivos y están devastados. Aunque no está claro qué sucedió, el médico examinador señala una marca de anillo en la piel del niño.

videos.title: Enfermo
videos.overview: Un niño de 12 años es sorprendido haciendo amenazas aterradoras en Internet; y resulta que ha sido víctima de abuso sexual por un empresario rico de la industria juguetera, solapado por sus padres.

videos.title: Secreto
videos.overview: Jeff York (Dean Strange) aparece estrangulado a muerte en un barrio frecuentado por prostitutas. Al no aparecer su cartera, parece que algún trato salió mal.

videos.title: Criminal
videos.overview: Una mujer que estudió a delincuentes es asesinada; y su mentor, un antiguo delincuente, parece ser el principal sospechoso.

videos.title: Sin dolor
videos.overview: Christina Nerrit (Karen Young) aparece en su apartamento con una bolsa de plástico cubriendo su cabeza y sus manos esposadas, para morir, pero sobrevive.

videos.title: Atados
videos.overview: Donna Brooksaparece muerta en su apartamento y un galán pretendiente, Richard Sutton (Richard Easton), se encuentra en el lugar; se cree que está muerto, pero vive. Sufrió un infarto al encontrar su cuerpo sin vida.

videos.title: Venenos
videos.overview: Una joven chica rumana, Alexis Campbell, adoptada por una familia estadounidense, se encuentra moribunda luego de que se extraen dos tazas de detergente de su estómago.

videos.title: Cabeza
videos.overview: Acusan a un niño de abusar de él después de un partido de fútbol, pero él no lo admite. Su director y su entrenador de fútbol son los principales sospechosos.

videos.title: Birthright
videos.overview: The investigation into the attempted kidnapping of a six year old girl uncovers a fertility doctor's scheme to steal embryos, and prompts a custody battle between the child's biological and birth mothers.

videos.title: Debt
videos.overview: As Benson and Stabler investigate the disappearance of a mother and her teenaged daughter, they uncover a conspiracy between a corrupt immigration attorney and gangsters running a prostitution ring that is staffed by women they have smuggled into the country and imprisoned as sex slaves.

videos.title: Obscene
videos.overview: With the encouragement of a radio host, who has a dirty mouth on him, one teenager is raped and another is imprisoned when they are thrown together by the manipulative adults in their lives whose sole motivations are celebrity and publicity for their own self-serving interests.

videos.title: Scavenger
videos.overview: The entire squad races against the clock to solve the puzzles and uncover the clues scattered throughout the city by a serial killer who is taunting them to find him and the next victims on his list.

videos.title: Outcry
videos.overview: A missing teenager found beaten and tied up in a college dormitory under construction claims that she was raped by three students, but as the investigation proceeds and information obtained by the police and the press causes her story to unravel quickly, the girl recants. Since Benson remains convinced that a rape did occur, the focus of the investigation shifts to the girl's overly-protective stepfather who has resisted the investigation from its onset.

videos.title: Conscience
videos.overview: The detectives and the district attorney get played first by the teenage murderer of a young boy, and then by the victim's father, who uses his professional expertise to escape punishment for avenging his son's death.

videos.title: Charisma
videos.overview: A career con artist, forger and thief turns to murder and serial pedophilia to populate the cult he created and to get his hands on a multi-million dollar trust fund. The detectives have trouble getting any leads because no one in the cult is saying anything, not even their names.

videos.title: Doubt
videos.overview: When a college student claims rape and her professor claims it was consensual sex, Stabler and Benson find themselves in the middle of a he said, she said battle, trying to decide whether to believe the alleged victim, or the alleged perpetrator who claimed she liked it rough. Benson sides with Myra, the victim, whereas Stabler finds himself wondering if Polikoff is telling the truth about being innocent, especially after Myra falsely accuses Stabler of touching her inappropriately. After giving more thought to the situation, Benson and Stabler each wonder if the other is right. Stabler has bigger problems on his hands, though, as Myra's attorney reveals that Kathy has moved out and taken the children.

videos.title: Weak
videos.overview: After arguing with Benson about their personal lives, Stabler enlists the help of a former cop turned psychiatrist in apprehending a serial rapist and murderer who attacks disabled women.

videos.title: Haunted
videos.overview: Fin is reunited with his own son as he risks his life to save two small children, one caught in the middle of a bodega robbery and the other from the junkie who set the child's mother up for murder and then stole him to use as a front in her scheme to boost materials for her meth lab.

videos.title: Contagious
videos.overview: After a car accident a nine-year-old girl is examined and it's found she's been sexually abused. Out of fear and desperation, the girl blames her soccer coach for molesting her. Soon a slew of other girls claim they also have been raped by the same coach. During the investigation, Benson has to try keeping Stabler from falling apart as his wife has left him.

videos.title: Identity
videos.overview: Complications ensue in the investigation of a Stone Cold Assassins gangbanger who fell off a building after the victim that he tried to rape bit him in self-defense when the vic's twin sister cops to the crime, seemingly impossible due to the evidence until the secrets regarding the sister's true genetic identity are revealed.

videos.title: Quarry
videos.overview: When the body of a seven-year-old child is found, the squad again begins to investigate convicted serial killer Lucas Biggs, believing that he molested and murdered the boy. While Biggs can detail every child he ever molested, he swears that he has no memory of this one. Further investigations show that there is another suspect, but before he can be picked up, someone picks him off.

videos.title: Game
videos.overview: The squad is at a loss on what to do with a violent homicide when Stabler's son points out that the event is straight out of a video game. Interviewing the game's creators leads them to a former employee, who then leads them (with a few other steps along the way) to a teenage couple who claim to be unable to distinguish fantasy from reality.

videos.title: Hooked
videos.overview: When the body of a teenager is found with her older cousin's I.D., Benson and Stabler investigate only to learn that that the teen had been part of a group who had 'hooked up' online. As their investigation intensified, they realised that the victim was the object of an older man's obsession, but before they can arrest him he also turns up dead.

videos.title: Ghost
videos.overview: When a wealthy couple is found dead in their home, Benson and Stabler soon realise that their deaths are connected to a drug smuggling ring. Eventually the road leads back to the same drug dealers who forced a former assistant district attorney into hiding, and Alex Cabot comes home to face her enemies.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: Fourteen years ago, Stabler had a chance to nail Gordon Rickett for the abduction, rape and murder of Dana MacNamara, but Rickett managed to get off. With the recent discovery of the body of Kerry Lynn Palmer, Stabler has another chance at cracking the case. They can only hold Rickett for twenty-four hours, but are able to glean enough information during that time period to at least have a place to start. Cragen and Benson both worry that Stabler will let his hatred for the suspected child molester interfere with his ability to do his job.

videos.title: Pure
videos.overview: After an 18-year-old girl is kidnapped, psychic Sebastian Ballentine comes forward claiming to have information on the killings. Stabler refuses to believe that Ballentine is a real psychic, and is convinced that the hints he is dropping about the case indicate he is somehow involved.

videos.title: Intoxicated
videos.overview: When Denise Eldridge finds her fifteen-year-old daughter Carrie in bed with twenty-one-year-old Justin, she immediately calls police to have Justin charged with statuatory rape. Benson intercedes on behalf of Carrie, calling a children's rights lawyer to assist her, but when Denise turns up dead, Carrie and Justin both end up on the suspect list. Benson tries to get some help from Simone Bryce, but Bryce is obligated to protect her client.

videos.title: Night (I)
videos.overview: After a young woman is found raped and murdered near a nightclub with five hundred dollars stuffed into her mouth, Benson and Stabler follow the fingerprint trail on the money to Attorney Jason Whitaker, whose sole responsibility seems to be handling the trust for the Duvall family. Soon detectives are convinced that Gabriel Duvall is their rapist, but don't have quite enough evidence to put him away. ADA Novak is working on both the case and a terrified former victim when she is brutally attacked in her office late at night. The crossover continues on Law & Order: Trial by Jury S01:E11 Day (II).

videos.title: Blood
videos.overview: After a young woman's baby is tossed out of a car, Benson and Stabler investigate to find out what happened, and after learning the young woman is addicted to prescription pain killers, their investigation leads them to an elderly woman named Jenny Rogers, who lives with her son Kevin and daughter-in-law Carol. The young woman finally identifies Carol Rogers as the person who solds her the drugs, but when detectives go to confront Carol they find her body, and are left trying to uncover who really killed Carol.

videos.title: Parts
videos.overview: After a woman's head is found in a car junkyard, the detectives track it down to the black market.

videos.title: Goliath
videos.overview: After the wife of a police officer claims her husband raped her, Benson and Stabler arrest the man and come close to believing his version of events when he attacks his captain. When another officer murders his wife and attempts to kill himself that same night, the whole force gets involved and soon realises that the two men both recently returned home from Afghanistan, where they were given the drug Quinium, an anti-malarial. With the reluctant help of reporter Sherm Hempell and a base doctor with an attack of conscience, Novak takes on the U.S. army. Stabler has trouble with the case because of his history in the marines.

videos.title: Demons
videos.overview: Twenty years after being convicted of the rape of a teenage girl, Ray Schenkel is released, much to the dismay of retired detective William Dorsey. When a teenage girl is raped on the route Schenkel would have taken home, Stabler goes undercover as a recently paroled sex offender so that he can get into the same therapy group as Schenkel, and the same halfway house. Cragen worries that Stabler may be getting in over his head.

videos.title: Design (I)
videos.overview:
Benson saves April Troost from committing suicide, but feels responsible when Troost dies during the trial of the man she accuses of raping her and getting her pregnant. It isn't long before detectives learn that Barclay Pallister wasn't the only man April picked up in a bar who has no recollection of sleeping with her, and the squad realizes that Troost was no victim. Their search takes them from prospective parents looking to adopt her child to the men she drugged and accosted to the sperm center she used to work at, which ends up at the center of the case.

This crossover continues on Law & Order S16E02 Flaw (II).

Benson is on her way out for the evening when a call comes in from a little girl who says she's all alone. While trying to draw the girl out, Benson is drawn deeper into the little girl's life, and although the other officers begin to suspect the whole thing may be some sick joke, Benson is convinced that the little girl is the real deal. By talking to Maria, Benson is able to ferret enough information from her so that they have a place to start, but Maria's captor has an affinity for electronics and has done everything he can to make sure that no one can find the little girl he bought and paid for.

videos.title: Ripped
videos.overview: When the teenage son of Stabler's old partner comes under suspicion for attacking a classmate, Stabler's inability to treat this like any other case gets him suspended.

videos.title: Strain
videos.overview: The discovery of the bodies of two young gay men who were both meth addicts as well as victims of a new strain of AIDS that can kill its victims in less than a year leads to an investigation. Tutuola learns that his son, Ken, is gay, and has difficulty accepting it, even though he and Benson end up going to Ken for help with infiltrating an anti-meth group. The group's leader, Gabriel, soon becomes their top suspect when the squad realises that the two men died because they passed the disease on.

videos.title: Raw
videos.overview: After a six-year-old boy dies in a school shooting, detectives trace the gun used back to a white supremacist's gun shop. Munch and Tutuola both face hatred and prejudice from the major suspects in the case, but their investigation soon takes them from the man who pulled the trigger back to the gun shop owner, who makes no bones about his hatred of anyone who isn't white.

videos.title: Name
videos.overview: After the bones of a boy who disappeared in 1978 are found at a playground, Stabler, still visibly recovering from a recent gunshot wound, teams up with Vizcarrando to determine the boy's identity, which leads them to a cold case involving four missing Puerto Rican boys that were never found.

videos.title: Starved
videos.overview: After a dating service is linked to three rapes, Olivia goes undercover to ferret out the rapist and meets Mike Jergens, a surgeon who enjoys controlling the women in his life. The detectives are soon led to his girlfriend, Cora Kennison, but shortly after testifying in the grand jury hearing Cora marries Mike. After Cora attempts suicide, Mike fights her mother, Virginia, to unplug her feeding tube.

videos.title: Rockabye
videos.overview: After sixteen-year-old Lauren Westley loses her unborn child due to a severe abdominal beating, her father's insistence that Lauren was raped leads detectives to the baby's father, but it isn't long before the detectives realise that Lauren was an active party in her own beating, and the two teens had found it necessary to take the steps they did because the abortion clinic kept putting off Lauren's request for an appointment. Novak faces a tough opponent in her own office when she and Branch disagree over the appropriate action to be taken against Wayne Mortens, the young girl's boyfriend.

videos.title: Storm
videos.overview: When a teenager and her younger sister end up in the hospital after a day at the park, detectives learn that both girls were abducted from New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina along with a third sister who is still missing. Despite the interference of a local reporter, Jackson Zane, detectives are able to catch the kidnapper, a known pedophile, and recover the girl, but when Alvin Dutch dies and the autopsy determines it was Anthrax, Benson puts everything on the line so that she can get the truth out there.

videos.title: Alien
videos.overview: After young Sean Hamill is stabbed in the back at the schoolyard, detectives are led to Charlie Monaghan, the older boy who had previously gotten into trouble over Hamill, but it isn't long before their attention turns to Monaghan's half-sister Emma Boyd. Hamill had been torturing the little girl for months because she had two mothers. After getting a nice deal for Emma's side, Benson and Stabler are thrown for a loop when Emma's biological grandparents accuse Zoe, who had never legally adopted Emma, of sexually molesting the little girl, and evidence seems to support their claims.

videos.title: Infected
videos.overview: Monica Phelps is found dead in her apartment, her son Nathan hiding in the closet behind her body. Detectives soon link Monica's death to philanthropist Ted Carthage, who runs an organization dedicated to helping people get off the streets. Benson is certain that Carthage is the killer, but a shaky ID from Nathan puts him back on the street. After Nathan kills Carthage himself, Sophie Devere argues that Nathan committed the killing because he saw Carthage shoot his mother -- something the gun manufacturers don't like.

videos.title: Blast
videos.overview: The team investigates when young Carly Hunter disappears while walking home from school one day. While processing evidence found at the scene, Warner realises that the little girl has leukemia, and they need to get her home as soon as possible to begin treatment. Despite the ransom drop going wrong, the detectives are able to find the little girl thanks to evidence O'Halloran finds at the scene, but as she tells her story to Stabler and her mother, it soon becomes clear that her kidnapper is someone very close to home. Stabler and Warner end up becoming hostages when the kidnapper approaches Jake Hunter directly.

videos.title: Taboo
videos.overview: A college co-ed's tale of rape and an unknown pregnancy is suspect after detectives learn that she's been linked to not one but two abandoned newborns.

videos.title: Manipulated
videos.overview: After the body of Vicky Riggs is found, Benson and Stabler delve into her private life and finally learn that in addition to being a respected lawyer, she was also a stripper. A surveillance photo leads them to Linus McKellen, her boss' husband, who was also having an affair with her. There isn't enough evidence to prove he murdered Vicky, but when Vicky's co-worker at the club, Josie Post, is also found murdered, DNA proves that McKellen's semen was found in her body, despite his disabled wife Tessa's conviction that he would never murder anyone. Suspicion turns on Tessa herself once the detectives interview the only man who seems capable of having committed the murders.

videos.title: Gone
videos.overview: Doug Waverly and Nick Pratt are charged with rape and murder in the disappearance of Canadian student Jennifer Durning after Nick's cousin, Jason King, claims that while he had consensual sex with her that night the other two raped her. A stray pubic hair leads Novak to Keith Willis, a drunk who was paid off by the boys to get Jennifer out of the hotel and who later saw the boys kidnap her, but Willis exactly fit to be a witness as his mind has gone after years of alcohol abuse. Jason King disappears. Although they are able to find a bug in Donnelly's office, they are not able to prove that it was placed there by Pratt or Waverly. Judge Donnelly is forced to dismiss the case against the two boys since there is no case without Jason's testimony.

videos.title: Class
videos.overview: After Carolyn Pereira's body is dumped in an area frequented by prostitutes, Stabler and Tutuola soon realise she had far more money than a student on financial aid should have had, and learn that she was deeply involved in the worlds of online gambling and high stakes poker. Suspects include the Gloria Culhane, the roommate who ended up with the very expensive ring that Caroline stole from a star athlete, Roddy Franklin, the star athlete who had his ring taken by Caroline, and Adam Halder, Caroline's best friend from childhood who turned out to be her backup during her online gambling forays. Stabler makes a special plea for Halder, feeling like he and the young man have something in common because both were boys from the wrong side of the tracks dealing with rich kids who treated them like dirt.

videos.title: Venom
videos.overview: Ken Randall calls Benson for help after he's picked up in an alley late at night. He claims that he was looking for a body after overhearing a man talk about murdering a woman and dumping her body while he was at the bar that night. Tutuola is upset that no one informed him, and determined to clear his son's name even though Ken immediately gets his own lawyer. Tutuola turns his eye on Ken's cousin, Darius Parker, who was with Ken that night and has been in and out of trouble for years, and after Ken voluntarily submits his DNA to clear his name, a shocking family connection between Darius and Ken is revealed. Darius confesses to having murdered the woman and her baby, but his confession is out because no one had contacted his lawyer.

videos.title: Fault
videos.overview: A manhunt ensues when Victor Paul Gitano, a recently released sex offender, kidnaps two children after killing the rest of their family. Benson and Stabler pursue Gitano only to find their own relationship challenged as both experience opportunities where they put their personal relationship ahead of their job. After having her throat slashed, Benson requests for a new partner when she hears what Stabler has to say about their relationship and their job.

videos.title: Fat
videos.overview: Stabler teams up with an new partner to investigate a sexual attack on Jessica DeLay, a sixteen-year-old girl who worked tobacco stings for the Department of Health and face an overweight young brother and sister who claim it was an act of vengeance for Jessica and her friend, Tommy Strahan, beating up their older brother Rudi for being fat. Stabler and Blaine arrest DeLay and Strahan, but when the two are released due to lack of admissable evidence, Rudi Bixton takes justice into his own hands.

videos.title: Web
videos.overview: When an eight-year-old propositions a male classmate, Stabler and Tutuola are called in to investigate the case and soon learn that Jake Winnock's father spent seven years in prison for molesting his older brother, Teddy. D.N.A. tests clear Gregory Hensal of abusive his son, but implicate Jake's older brother, whom detectives soon learn has been running his own personal Internet pornography site. T.A.R.U. tech Ruben Morales joins the detectives in their search for Teddy after he goes missing, but his own guilt about his nephew's molestation after being raped by an online predator he met using the computer Morales had given him colors his judgment when dealing with one of the suspect's.

videos.title: Influence
videos.overview: After Jamie Hoskins falsely accuses two classmates of rape after a consensual act then hits nine pedestrians during an attempted suicide, medical tests reveal she has been taking medication for bipolar disorder and stopped her pills a week earlier. Jamie is charged with murder and released on her own recognizance after she agrees to take her medication, but after rock star Derek Lord, who is well known for his negative views on psychiatry, gets involved and begins spearheading her defense, Jamie again stops taking her medication. Novak is sympathetic to Jamie, but Jamie's insistence on following Derek Lord's advice leaves Novak with no choice but to take the case to trial.

videos.title: Informed
videos.overview: Benson is called in after a young woman shows up at the hospital, raped and beaten with her head shaved. Haley Kerns refuses to submit to a rape kit, but Benson steals her underwear before leaving the apartment and gives it to Warner to check out. When Benson returns to her apartment she encounters Star Morrison, who admits that Haley is a federal informant working with them on eco-terrorism. After Stabler is wounded while out on a search with Morrison, Benson and she work to get information from Haley before the eco-terrorists can strike.

videos.title: Clock
videos.overview: Stabler and Tutuola pair up to investigate when two teens go missing while their school is on a field trip to a local museum. Their investigation soon turns up evidence that the disappearance was staged to help Janey, who suffers from Turner's Syndrome, be with her older boyfriend, a man with a prediliction for young girls, and to help the boy, Connor, make good on a gambling debt. Stabler experiences a rift with his daughter, Kathleen, who is upset over the way that he has handled her relationship with a young man named Kevin.

videos.title: Recall
videos.overview: Stabler and his new partner, Dani Beck, investigate the rape of a young woman named Nikki, who soon identifies a prominent lawyer, Martin Trenway, as her rapist. The squad has difficulty making the charges stick until another victim comes forward, but her testimony cannot be proven reliable. Determined to get at Trenway, Beck tracks down a woman from his past who holds the key to convicting Trenway, if they can convince her to expose the truth.

videos.title: Uncle
videos.overview: After a mother and her ten-year-old daughter are found raped and butchered in their apartment, Stabler and Beck take in a homeless man who turns out to be Munch's uncle, Andrew. Initially he's their main suspect until they find their way to a new suspect. Unfortunately, when their only evidence against Brent Allen Banks is thrown out in court, Andrew, suffering from mental illness, goes too far trying to do what he is convinced is the right thing.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: Stabler and Beck disagree on how to handle a case involving a rapist who seems to be escalating his attacks. Beck is getting too personally involved in the case and with the victims, which Stabler warns her against. The key witness in the case is a pregnant woman who denies having been raped more than once by the man, whose goal appears to have been to impregnate the women.

videos.title: Infiltrated
videos.overview: Novak tries to find Benson when the case for a previous rape victim, Chelsea Arndale, hinges on her testimony. Benson, meanwhile, is still living as Persephone James and has been arrested in Oregon after the ecologist's group she has infiltrated is involved in a fracas with the local police. After the local sheriff advises her that her group is being looked at in connection with a recent murder, Benson decides to do a little investigating on her own and learns that the man was a pedophile. When she finally finds his private hideaway, it leads to a shocking conclusion.

videos.title: Underbelly
videos.overview: After a third young teen is found dead, a paw print tattoo on her lower back, Stabler and Beck investigate the tattoo, which leads them to Broder House, a foster home for young girls. They learn that Chantal was one of a number of girls who had ended up working the streets for a man named Victor. Stabler warns Beck that she can't get emotionally involved in every case, but the two work together to bring down Victor, relying on one of his girls to get the evidence that they need.

videos.title: Cage
videos.overview: After a van containing two young children ends up in the river, Beck finds herself drawn to the young girl, Eden, and the investigation into a tape found in the vehicle turns up a mysterious death involving a controversial attachment therapy technique. Beck tries to do the right thing by saving Eden, only to find herself torn when it seems as though there is nothing she can do to help. The investigation into the rebirthing turns up a foster family who abuses the children in their care, but not all of the children agree that it was abuse.

videos.title: Choreographed
videos.overview: After Danielle Masoner dies in Central Park, Stabler follows the leads to a homeless man who turns out to be a better witness than he thought. Paired up again with Benson, Stabler investigates her death, but it keeps bringing up memories of Dani Beck for him. During the course of the investigation, Benson and Stabler learn that Danielle's husband was sleeping with a friend of theirs, leading the squad to suspect first him, but their suspicion soon turns to the husband of the other woman.

videos.title: Scheherazade
videos.overview: Stabler heads to see terminal cancer patient Judson Tierney after a request from his parish priest, and soon realizes that Tierney has a story that he is dying to tell but only wants to tell to his estranged daughter. With Benson keeping an eye on Tierney, Stabler looks into the man's past and learns that he was once involved in a series of unsolved bank robberies, and that he has been keeping a secret about his daughter for over twenty years.

videos.title: Burned
videos.overview: Stabler and Benson find themselves on opposite sides when Valerie Sennet accuses her estranged husband, Miles Sennet, of breaking into her home and raping her. Because Miles has no history of violence and Valerie refuses to allow detectives to use her daughter Tessa as a witness, he is soon released, and Stabler and Benson continue to clash as Benson remains convinced that Miles raped Valerie and is a danger, and Stabler believes it may be a case of a wife crying foul to punish her soon-to-be ex-husband.

videos.title: Outsider
videos.overview: Tutuola reluctantly works on a case involving the rape of a coed after his son Ken feels responsible for catching the rapist. Tutuola trying to solve the case with the rape victim unwilling to cooperate, crosses paths with another detective, Chester Lake, who is also investigating similar cases as part of Brooklyn SVU. The two clash at first but when another rape occurs, the two detectives must work together and pick up the pace before the rapist strikes again.

videos.title: Loophole
videos.overview: Stabler ends out being out of commission after a perpetrator high on PCP throws him through a window at the station, so Benson teams up with Munch and Tutuola to investigate a mysterious packet of photos. The photographs lead them to both a suspected child pornographer and a junkie burgler, but after Benson takes ill during the investigation, the team realises that there is more than child pornography at stake as their investigation soon reveals that Seth Millstead wasn't into little boys at all, but had been using the tenants of the apartment building in an experiment for a new pesticide.

videos.title: Dependent
videos.overview: Benson and Stabler attempt to question a confused young woman about an attack on her parents that left her brother traumatized and Stabler puts his career on the line when he goes too far.

videos.title: Haystack
videos.overview: Stabler finds himself drawn into a case where a young mother has committed suicide after her baby goes missing. The case leads to questions for Benson about her own family history.

videos.title: Philadelphia
videos.overview: Benson finds herself in a bad situation when she has a closer link to a suspect than she ever could have expected.

videos.title: Sin
videos.overview: Stabler and Benson suspect a charismatic preacher in a case of murder until his wife provides them with another viable suspect.

videos.title: Responsible
videos.overview: Stabler seeks Kathleen's help when investigating a case involving teenage alcohol abuse.

videos.title: Florida
videos.overview: When Detective Benson gets into the middle of an investigation of her brother Simon Marsden, the case begins to threaten her career. As Simon makes a run for it, Benson investigates further into his family life, and begins to question whether or not she was the product of a rape in the first place.

videos.title: Annihilated
videos.overview: A woman's murder appears to be the result of a professional hit, when her fiancé receives death threats, apparently resulting from his CIA career. Elliot, investigating this, finds that the man may not be all that he seems.

videos.title: Pretend
videos.overview: The team investigates the death of a partially clothed teenage boy wearing a leather mask. The detectives discover that the victim's best friend is the killer and has a video, showing that the boy's death was the result of a backyard wrestling match gone wrong.

videos.title: Screwed
videos.overview: Darius Parker, goes on trial for the rape and murder of a woman and her 14-month old child. The case brings Fin under fire from the media and even has Munch and Stabler at odds. Novak prosecutes the trial that brings Stabler and Tutuola, among others, to the stand. Many previous stories are brought into the trial.

videos.title: Alternate
videos.overview: Benson and Stabler investigate a suspected child abuse case only to learn that the woman who reported it is the real case.

videos.title: Avatar
videos.overview: Detectives are troubled to learn that someone has taken an online game too far when a girl goes missing.

videos.title: Impulsive
videos.overview: A teacher claims that a student pursued her after she's charged with raping him.

videos.title: Savant
videos.overview: The only witness to a young woman's horrific beating is her mentally challenged daughter.

videos.title: Harm
videos.overview: Benson and Stabler investigate the connection between the New York murder of college counselor Kate Simes and her volunteer work at a refugee center working with soldiers tortured in Iraq.

videos.title: Svengali
videos.overview: Benson comes under fire from fans of a convicted serial killer after a body turns up that greatly resembles his work.

videos.title: Blinded
videos.overview: Novak confronts ghosts from her past while handling the trial of a schizophrenic serial rapist, who seriously injured Stabler.

videos.title: Fight
videos.overview: Detectives find themselves embroiled in the world of ultimate fighting after a young girl's death.

videos.title: Paternity
videos.overview: When the paternity of a missing young boy is placed into question, Stabler wonders if he really is the father of Kathy's child. Later, Stabler faces the possibility of losing not only his partner but also Kathy and the baby when she and Benson are in an accident.

videos.title: Snitch
videos.overview: When a polygamist's wife is murdered, he believes it's related to a recent criminal case he was testifying in, but detectives believe it may be connected to his culture.

videos.title: Streetwise
videos.overview: A Park Avenue socialite's body is found in NYC'S Central Park, and Detectives Benson and Stabler initially suspect her wealthy boyfriend.

videos.title: Signature
videos.overview: A woman's body is found murdered in a park alongside a man with a bullet in his head - Benson and Special Agent Cooper join forces and suspect "The Woodsman", a serial killer Cooper has tried to catch for years. Lake and Benson begin to question Cooper's true motives when the male victim is later identified as "The Woodsman".

videos.title: Unorthodox
videos.overview: Benson and Stabler investigate a tutor after a student is beaten and sexually assaulted, but their investigation soon leads them to another student.

videos.title: Inconceivable
videos.overview: The robbery of fertilized embryos from a sperm bank call for Benson and Stabler to track down the thief. Clues from the clinic's security tape lead them to a long list of suspects including two publicity-hungry extremists. The detectives race against the clock to find the missing embryos, but that isn't the only clock that's ticking - Olivia considers her own fertility and the possibility of motherhood.

videos.title: Undercover
videos.overview: After a woman was found raped in a garden, Benson and Stabler realize that the case goes much deeper because of the victim's mother, drugs, and the realization that a corrections officer is involved. Benson decides to go undercover at the same prison where the mother is, putting herself on the other side of the fence.

videos.title: Closet
videos.overview: After investment banker Jeremy Haynes is found dead, suspicions turns to his boyfriend Lincoln Haver, a professional football player who could lose everything if the truth of his sexuality became public. When news of Haver's sexual orientation comes out, Benson comes under fire for her relationship with a reporter.

videos.title: Authority
videos.overview: An engineer plays a series of mind games with Benson and Stabler.

videos.title: Trade
videos.overview: When a pregnant woman's body is discovered in a burned-out brownstone, the investigation turns to a family of coffee importers.

videos.title: Cold
videos.overview: The squad is left at ends when Lake is caught in a gunfight and later takes a witness hostage.

videos.title: Trials
videos.overview: After a young boy, Christopher Ryan, is caught driving a runaway van, Detective Elliot Stabler and Detective Benson take the seven year-old into questioning. When Christopher claims his foster parents, Gwen and Noah Sibert, bribe him in exchange for abusive medical testing, the detectives investigate his allegations.

videos.title: Confesión
videos.overview: Eric, un adolescente, llega a la estación de policía para confesar sus sentimientos sexuales por su hermanastro, pero Stabler y Benson no están muy seguros de cómo manejar la situación porque no se ha cometido ningún delito.

videos.title: Ritmo
videos.overview: La hija de Elliot, Kathleen, entra en la casa de una pareja y les roba un colgante, por lo que Elliot se ve obligado a enfrentar fantasmas de su pasado. Por desgracia, sus errores ponen en riesgo el futuro y la salud mental de Kathleen.

videos.title: Locura
videos.overview: El equipo lleva a cabo una investigación, cuando el brutal homicidio de un astronauta toma lugar; y las pistas resultantes parecen señalar como posible responsable del crimen a un violador serial. Más tarde aparecen nuevos cadáveres que podrían estar relacionados con el caso, y Elliot decide tomar medidas al respecto.

videos.title: Retro
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler buscar la ayuda de Warner mientras investigan el caso de un bebé con SIDA, pronto la investigación apunta hacia un médico homeópata con una ética cuestionable que le había recetado vitaminas ineficaces al el bebé.

videos.title: Chicas
videos.overview: Cuando un vagabundo es hallado muerto, castrado e incinerado, Stabler y Munch deben seguir las pistas que conducen a una escuela secundaria en donde hay dos grupos: uno compuesto por chicas que han hecho un pacto para quedar embarazadas, y otro cuyos inte.

videos.title: Wildlife
videos.overview: Stabler goes undercover to infiltrate a rare animal smuggling operation.

videos.title: Persona
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler trabajan para exponer la verdad sobre una falsa denuncia de violación pero todo su esfuerzo podría perderse cuando la víctima se retracta; y los intentos de Olivia por mantener a salvo a la mujer sacan a la luz un secreto más profundo y conmovedor.

videos.title: PTSD
videos.overview: The death of a marine who was pregnant by a rapist puts the unit at odds with the Pentagon when they fight to keep the case, and Benson's flashbacks of her own assault may further impede the investigation.

videos.title: Tizón
videos.overview: Una mujer golpeada y violada no recuerda nada de lo que le pasó, así que pone a Benson y Stabler en la pista de un violador serial cuyas víctimas no saben que han sido atacadas. Pero más tarde, una circunstancia casual hace que el juicio sea declarado nulo.

videos.title: Extraño
videos.overview: Una chica que había desaparecido cuatro años atrás, reaparece contando una terrible historia de encarcelamiento y esclavitud sexual, pero Benson y Stabler dudan de sus declaraciones ya que se producen discrepancias y aparecen pruebas en su contra.

videos.title: Invernáculo
videos.overview: Encuentran el cadáver de una adolescente en el Hudson y para poder identificarlo, Benson debe trabajar de incógnito haciéndose pasar por una madama. Pero esa es la parte fácil, ya que la investigación conduce a un padre abusivo.

videos.title: Snatched
videos.overview: The mother of a kidnapped young girl points the detectives towards her father, an ex-con, but it is soon discovered that the grandfather is a master thief and has many enemies. However, because of Alzheimer's, the grandfather can't remember much of his past.

videos.title: Transitions
videos.overview: The detectives have very little to work with after a man is found badly-beaten in a strip club's parking lot. Their questioning begins with the dancers until the victim's ex-wife and 13-year old transgender daughter become suspects.

videos.title: Guiar
videos.overview: Un pediatra acusado de acoso sexual a sus pacientes es hallado muerto, luego de amenazar con una contrademanda a su clínica y al departamento de policía.

videos.title: Bailarina
videos.overview: El asesinato de una persona de repente se convierte en una escena con tres cadáveres. Benson y Stabler deben trabajar con el dueño de un club de strip-tease para encontrar a un asesino cuyos motivos podrían relacionarse más con la rectitud.

videos.title: Hell
videos.overview: Detective Munch investigates the brutal rape and beating of a young mute girl, but things become tricky when her drawing of the devil who attacked her resembles a local priest who may not be practicing his beliefs according to Canon.

videos.title: Equipaje
videos.overview: Se produce una lucha territorial, cuando Stabler y Tutuola vinculan el asesinato de un artista con un asesino serial y el detective asignado al caso se concentra más en luchar contra los detectives porque considera que la investigación le pertenece a él.

videos.title: Selfish
videos.overview: A grandmother reports that her 2 year old granddaughter has disappeared, but the Amber Alert fails to yield progress. The detectives then move their attention over to her young irresponsible mother as their prime suspect.

videos.title: Crush
videos.overview: A teenage girl who sent text messages containing nude pictures of herself is found beaten up. She next faces a harsh sentence from a judge after being arrested for producing and distributing child pornography.

videos.title: Libertades
videos.overview: Un demandante que busca una orden de restricción provoca una extraña solicitud de un juez (Alan Dale): Quiere que los detectives interroguen a un asesino serial condenado por el secuestro de su hijo, que ocurrió hace 30 años.

videos.title: Zebras
videos.overview: A murder in Central Park that involves a tourist puts the SVU on high alert, but when the suspect they've brought in for questioning escapes, Munch has to reach out to an ex-wife in an effort to prevent another killing that's closer to home.

videos.title: Inestable
videos.overview: Una víctima forma un vínculo con el oficial que la rescata, así que obliga a Benson y Stabler a trabajar con el temperamental policía para cerrar el caso. Por desgracia, el caso se complica.

videos.title: Azúcar
videos.overview: Una maleta con el cadáver de una joven conduce a Benson y Stabler a investigar a su amante, en este nuevo episodio de Ley y Orden: UVE.

videos.title: Solitary
videos.overview: When Lily Milton is reported missing, her boyfriend, Parker Hubbard, points Detectives Benson and Stabler in the direction of Callum Donovan, Lily's downstairs neighbor and convicted bank robber who spent nineteen years in solitary confinement. During the investigation into Donovan's alibi, Lily is found alive, adding a surprising twist to the case and exposing more of Donovan's dark past.

videos.title: Hammered
videos.overview: After a night of heavy drinking, Dalton Rindell wakes up to a bloody apartment, a terrible cut on his head and a dead woman in his bed. Unable to recall the night before, Rindell immediately calls the police. Detectives Benson and Stabler suspect the crime is the result of a deadly love triangle; however Rindell does not recognize the victim. After questioning Rindell and the victim's family and friends, Benson and Stabler are provided with leads in several different directions. Unsure which lead to follow, the two detectives decide to return to the bar where the night began in order to piece together the gruesome truth.

videos.title: cableado
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler investigan una organización de pedofilia que dice que el trastorno está "predestinado" cuando una mujer dice que su hijo ha sido victimado por uno de sus miembros.

videos.title: asustado
videos.overview: Mientras Benson y Stabler investigan la muerte de una pareja conectada con el cartel de la droga, Benson encuentra un rostro conocido en una casa abandonada posiblemente usada para fabricar drogas.

videos.title: Usuarios
videos.overview: El equipo investiga al padre de una adolescente asesinada cuya foto en la escena del crimen se distribuyó ampliamente por Internet, pero creen que han encontrado a alguien más sospechoso cuando hablan con el terapeuta de la chica.

videos.title: Confusión
videos.overview: Stabler está dividido entre un caso de violación, de una chica que había publicado fotos de ella en Internet, y su propio hijo, que tiene un amigo cuyas acciones podrían poner en peligro una vida y el futuro de ambos.

videos.title: Perverted
videos.overview: DNA links Olivia to the murder of a biker in Central Park whose gang specialized in hits and prostitution. With Munch and Fin assigned to the investigation and evidence continuing to mount against Benson, Elliot begins his own inquiry – determined to prove her innocence and save her career.

videos.title: Anchor
videos.overview: Fin's investigation into three little girl's deaths takes him into the world of immigration, anchor babies, a grassroots opposition movement, a radio talk show host who fans the hatred, and an immigration rights attorney who is somehow tied up in everything.

videos.title: Cosa hecha rápidamente
videos.overview: Un caso se convierte en dos cuando un asesinato conduce a un violador serial que está transmitiendo enfermedades a sus víctimas y la única pista de los detectives es un sitio web para encuentros casuales y anónimos.

videos.title: Shadow
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler investigan la muerte de una pareja adinerada que fue hallada muerta en su cama y deben trabajar en conjunto con un detective de la división de fraude que está convencido de que la hija de la pareja cometió el crimen.

videos.title: ordenador personal
videos.overview: Los detectives investigan el caso de una violación que se convirtió en asesinato, pero la investigación se ve obstaculizada por una lesbiana prominente que tiene su propias ideas.

videos.title: Salvador
videos.overview: Stabler y Benson persiguen al asesino de una prostituta que cree que tiene una misión divina.

videos.title: Confidencial
videos.overview: Benson y Stabler investigan el secuestro de una mujer en un edificio que es propiedad de un inversionista muy poderoso y protegido.

videos.title: Testigo
videos.overview: Una joven dice haber sido violada en la escalera de su edificio. Los detectives investigan la posibilidad de que la muchacha haya inventado la historia para llamar la atención pero luego se encuentran buscando desesperadamente a una testigo que dice habe

videos.title: Desactivado
videos.overview: Una ex cantante de ópera que sufre una enfermedad debilitante es hallada golpeada y violada. Como es evidente que la mujer es víctima de abuso crónico, el equipo amplía su investigación para incluir a las personas encargadas de cuidar de su salud.

videos.title: Bedtime
videos.overview: When a journalist is found raped and murdered in her own bed, Cragen is able to connect this particular case to another five murders that happened thirty years ago, committed by the "Bedtime Butcher". To uncover the truth behind the crimes, Benson goes undercover in order to find the real killer.

videos.title: estafado
videos.overview: Un caso de error de identidad complica la investigación del asesinato de una persona que la mayoría pensaba que era un asistente a una boda, a la que no había sido invitada, que se llevaba a cabo en el hotel en el que se encontró el cadáver.

videos.title: Beef
videos.overview: After a young woman is sexually assaulted and murdered, Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler track down the woman's boyfriend - their first suspect - but learn that he is a devout vegan who wouldn't hurt a fly. They soon find that the victim had been deeply involved in the fight to expose questionable practices in the meat-packing industry, even going undercover at a large company to find out the truth. Benson goes undercover herself to retrace the woman's footsteps and to identify who the victim might have angered along the way.

videos.title: Torch
videos.overview: After two young girls die in a fire, Stabler finds a familiar face in the prosecutor assigned to the case.

videos.title: Ace
videos.overview: When a pregnant woman is raped, Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler arrive at the hospital to find that she has fled. Even when someone is arrested for a similar offense, ADA Jo Marlowe says she doesn't have a case in court unless they find the victim and get a statement from her. Soon, Benson and Stabler connect the woman to an illegal adoption operation, forcing them to go undercover and expose the truth.

videos.title: Wannabe
videos.overview: After a man flashes customers at an electronics store, it is discovered that someone who matches his description has recently raped three young girls. Captain Donald Cragen orchestrates a movement to catch the rapist, and a rookie cop makes an arrest. Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler confirm that they've found their man, but after ADA Jo Marlowe expresses some doubts, it is soon discovered that the so-called rookie may have some secrets of his own.

videos.title: Shattered
videos.overview: The detectives end up in a dangerous situation while investigating the whereabouts of a kidnapped eight-year-old boy.

videos.title: Locum
videos.overview: Benson and Stabler are called to investigate when a little girl goes missing. They soon find out that the mother had another daughter who disappeared some years earlier and she becomes the focus of the investigation.

videos.title: Bullseye
videos.overview: The brutal rape of a ten-year-old girl leaves her unable to recall her own name. Unfortunately, once Fin assists with the ID, the detectives find that she's not the only one with memory impairment, and Dr. Huang is brought in to assess her home situation.

videos.title: Behave
videos.overview: A woman who has been raped multiple times is afraid to leave her house. The issue of unopened rape kits will see Detective Olivia Benson travel from New York City to Los Angeles.

videos.title: Merchandise
videos.overview: A teenage girl's death exposes a human trafficking ring and leads detectives Olivia Benson and Elliot Stabler to team up with an old friend at the U.S. Attorney's office.

videos.title: Wet
